program.name: Bell Lifts and EMOM
program.subject: Kettlebell only
program.blurb: Three bell lifts in straight sets, then a bell EMOM to the end.
program.about: Strength first, then the clock. Each day opens with three kettlebell lifts in straight sets, then an EMOM of four more bell moves, a set at the top of every minute. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for a heavier bell and Level III slows the lowering to three seconds.
program.split: Bell lifts, then a bell EMOM, A / B
